prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / stylized-concept.
Create the INTERIOR artwork of a PE Studio product cover for a GitHub portfolio. Very wide 3:1 landscape, ideally 2172 x 724 pixels. Image 1 is a style/layout/character reference only (Foundry cover): reuse the SAME gray-white chibi IP identity, high swept tied white hair, white face mask, glowing white eyes, gray hoodie and matching gray sneakers, high quality soft 3D clay / vinyl rendering. Image 2 is the EXACT PE Studio app icon reference: polished SILVER chrome letter P, curved lower stem, small pale-gold four-point sparkle at top-right. Preserve its recognizable design, do not substitute a generic P or F.
Layout: clean warm off-white background, one thin charcoal rounded rectangular inner border with generous margins, strong typography on LEFT 47%, illustration RIGHT 53%. No desktop window top bar, no outer category frame: that will be added by code afterward.
Exact left text, clean bold chunky rounded black typography:
"PE Studio"
"macOS 提示词专家"
Smaller feature line:
"三模型并行 · A/B/C 盲测"
A smooth teal underline beneath the large project name, with a few subtle teal and amber motion strokes.
Right illustration, a NEW interaction distinct from carrying a logo or sitting: the gray-white mascot stands in a lively three-quarter pose, one foot slightly forward with both legs and knees correctly connected. One hand actively uses an oversized warm-orange stylus to direct / compare THREE floating prompt cards labeled A, B, C (one teal, one lavender, one warm yellow), while the other hand rests naturally against the large polished silver P icon standing on a small clean work surface. The P icon and pale-gold sparkle remain prominent. Three glassy cards fan out around the app icon, with restrained typographic line marks representing prompts and a small check mark suggesting review. This symbolizes parallel prompt optimization and blind comparison; do not draw photos, generated art, videos or claim content generation.
Materials: silver P is reflective metal; cards and colored props remain colorful; IP character itself stays entirely grayscale, consistent with reference. Soft contact shadows, gentle studio light, polished friendly collectible figure styling.
Avoid: changing character identity, colored hair or clothing, skin-colored face, extra people, extra arms or legs, detached limbs, twisted joints, duplicated fingers, overly long limbs, repeated Foundry carrying pose, missing shoes, dense UI, tiny illegible paragraphs, logos of unrelated model providers, extra words, watermark, full desktop frame. Keep all content within the inner border. Make title and core features readable in a 2-column GitHub gallery.
